description: Declares which AssetSource loaders should be registered, and asset_id -> source hints. No loader is implemented in Phase W3, so registeredSources is expected to be an empty array until Phase W6 (asset pipeline activation).

assetHints.description: asset_id -> which source is expected to claim it, used purely as a lookup hint; AssetRegistry.resolve() dispatches by AssetLoader.can_load(), not by this list.
